title: Greetings at School Assembly
subject: English Language
objectives: Greet the headmaster and teachers politely
Understand how to greet during assembly

blocks.md: Every morning, teachers greet their pupils. Listen to how these pupils reply:

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Good morning, Tunde. How are you?

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: Yes, I did, thank you, sir.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Musa, the day will be bright today, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Zara, you are wearing beautiful braids today.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Ibrahim, did you rest well last night?

blocks.caption: The headmaster speaks to the whole school at assembly.

lines.speaker: Headmaster
lines.text: How are you all, dear children?

lines.speaker: Headmaster
lines.text: It is nice to see you all today.

lines.speaker: Headmaster
lines.text: Today is the first day of a new term.

lines.speaker: Headmaster
lines.text: Are you all ready to work hard?

lines.speaker: Headmaster
lines.text: I congratulate all the winners of the match.

lines.speaker: Headmaster
lines.text: You may all go back to your classes. Have a wonderful day.

blocks.md: **Remember:** At assembly, we greet the **headmaster**, the **teachers**, and our **friends**. Always answer politely with **'sir'** or **'ma'**.

quiz.q: Who speaks to the whole school at assembly?
quiz.explain: The headmaster leads the school assembly.

quiz.q: If the headmaster asks 'How are you all?', what do the pupils say?
quiz.explain: The correct polite answer is 'We are fine, sir.'

quiz.q: What should you say when a teacher says something kind to you?
quiz.explain: We always say 'Thank you' when someone is kind to us.
